retrievalProfile.description: A close-up urban portrait featuring a male subject in aviator sunglasses and a trench coat, paired with a large-scale script logo and secondary sans-serif title.
triggerTerms: urban R&B portrait with script logo
man in aviators and trench coat album cover
blue script typography over beige background
excludeWhen: minimalist black and white photography is requested
heavy grunge or industrial textures are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up of a man looking off-camera, wearing reflective aviator sunglasses and a light-colored trench coat. The background is a soft-focus urban environment. A large, stylized script name in blue with a drop shadow is positioned on the left, with a smaller sans-serif subtitle below it. A faint, oversized graphic watermark of the artist's initials sits in the background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame
Typography is anchored to the left third
Color palette balances warm skin tones with cool blue accents in the shirt and text
Reflections in sunglasses provide environmental context
Large background watermark creates depth behind the main text
coreInvariants: Stylized blue script for the primary name

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is a medium close-up, positioned on the right side of the frame, looking toward the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the reflective sunglasses serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the subject's face, follows his gaze to the left toward the script typography, and then down to the subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The left side of the frame provides negative space for the typography, filled with a subtle watermark.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Beige and cream (trench coat and background)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blue (script text and striped shirt)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-key lighting with saturated blue accents against a muted, warm-toned background.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a balance of warm and cool tones

letterConstructionRules: Large, sweeping flourishes on initial capitals
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'K' features a detached, stylized flourish
The 'J' has a deep, rounded descender
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a fluid, organic script with a rigid, geometric sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Large-scale background watermark of the artist's initials

preserve: The blue color of the script
The wide tracking of the subtitle
avoid: Centering the text over the subject's face

candidateDirections.reason: Clean, geometric sans-serif for the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium close-up of a man in a light beige trench coat and blue striped shirt, wearing aviator sunglasses, looking off-camera in a soft-focus urban setting. Include a very faint, large-scale beige watermark of stylized letters in the background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in a large, blue calligraphic script with a soft drop shadow in the upper left. Below it, add the title in a small, brown, all-caps sans-serif font with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the script text blue with a drop shadow?
Is the subject wearing aviator sunglasses?
Is the subtitle in all-caps with wide tracking?
Is the background watermark present but subtle?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject
Specific brand logos on clothing or sunglasses

mustAchieve: Legible typography against a busy background

postGenerationChecks: Check that the script text does not obscure the subject's face
Ensure the sunglasses reflections look natural
Verify the color harmony between the blue text and the blue shirt
Confirm the subtitle is perfectly aligned under the script
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Large Script Logo + Wide-Tracked Sans-Serif Subtitle + High-Key Lighting
